text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen overall, but that alone is not a reason to sell; I should assess each stock’s future prospects rather than react to recent losses.","Selling Stock A and Stock D for gains did not establish that I timed the market well; I should avoid treating realized gains as proof that a trade was wise.","Since prices move randomly, I should not trade to make up for losses or chase short-term moves; I should make deliberate decisions and accept that outcomes are uncertain."]}
